events_to_frames — DRIVE motion_io op

• Data kinds: table → voxel

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.events_to_frames(events: 'dict', n_frames: 'int' = 32, shape=None) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import motionio; motionio.events_to_frames(events: 'dict', n_frames: 'int' = 32, shape=None) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("events_to_frames"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

イベントを時間で n_frames に等分し、画素ごとに極性を足したコマ (T, H, W) にする(ON = +1、OFF = −1)。

全イベントの極性の和はコマの総和と一致する(落とすイベントは無い)。
